title: Michael's own memory: frozen at the wheel, bright light, human-shaped blurs
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I I do remember the simple fact that there's a big bright light in front of us. I do remember that it come close, it go back out and everything.

plain: In 1977, at a missile site called November 5 near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an Air Force man named Michael Johnson says he sat frozen at the wheel while a big bright light came close and moved away again, and blurred shapes like human figures appeared. Johnson tells Michels this as his own memory of the night he spent there with his partner, Mario Woods: "I do remember that it come close, it go back out." It is his own account of what he and Woods say was an abduction.
